why_large_model_has_not_beaten_mlp: Only2epochs/one seed/one topology; no isolated architecture or equal-compute HPO claim. Two new controlled variants change smoothing and then learning rate, not arbitrary extra capacity.
Smoothing.02 has8-class objective entropy floor different from unsmoothed MLP. Raw losses are not directly comparable; lower training loss is not independent generalization.
New low-smoothing/lr.0006 candidate AP.9990035 remains below MLP.9994364; recall/FPR tradeoffs vary by calibration budget. Larger capacity does not recover absent information.
No train/val actor/campaign identity overlaps, only2exact standardized-vector collisions; this does not establish semantic grammar independence or rule-independent labels.
All9validation campaigns are concurrent. Calibration3/selection6 are group-disjoint, not independent in time/environment; bootstrap6groups cannot certify production FPR.

97,065public CSIC records collapse to34,561observable request identities. Only1,713of25,065anomalies retain nonempty query under v2privacy projection; unobserved body/header attacks remain binary positives.
On full public test,32mixed-label static vectors imply14,967minimum errors from this view (24.51% empirical lower bound), not proof of bad publisher labels.
External frozen-threshold missing-view stress test: all GLU variants FPR100%; MLP recall1.3246%. This rejects deployment readiness, not an isolated architecture conclusion.
